About Euro Lanka

Your trusted partner for premium furniture accessories, bridging world-class Chinese manufacturing with Sri Lankan excellence.

Our Story

Founded in 2016, Euro Lanka began with a simple mission: bring world-class furniture accessories from China's top manufacturers directly to Sri Lanka's furniture industry.

What started as a small import operation has grown into a trusted name, serving hundreds of furniture businesses, interior designers, and homeowners across the island.

🇨🇳 China Import Excellence

🏭Direct partnerships with 15+ Chinese factories
🔍In-factory quality inspection before every shipment
📦Regular container shipments — new stock monthly
💎ISO-certified manufacturing partners
🌐Sourced from Guangzhou, Foshan & Shenzhen

Our Journey

Key milestones that shaped Euro Lanka.

2016

Founded

Euro Lanka established in Sri Lanka with a vision for premium imported furniture accessories.

2017

First Shipment

First direct container shipped from Guangzhou, China with 50+ product varieties.

2019

Expansion

Expanded to serve over 200 furniture businesses and interior designers across Sri Lanka.

2021

Quality Program

Launched strict QC program with in-factory inspection before every shipment.

2023

Digital Presence

Launched online catalog and expanded product range to 500+ items.

2024

1200+ Clients

Reached milestone of 1200+ satisfied clients. Trusted name in furniture accessories.
